    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    AbstractFileRepository<ID,E>
    Abstract base class for persisting entities to a text file.
    Entity<ID>
    Generic base class for all entities in the system.
    Friendship
    Entity modeling a friendship relationship between two users.
    FriendshipDbRepository
    Database repository implementation for managing Friendship entities.
    FriendshipFileRepository
    Repository for persisting friendship relationships to a text file (CSV).
    FriendshipRepository
    Repository for managing friendship relationships in memory.
    FriendshipValidator
    Validator for the Friendship entity.
    GraphService
    Service responsible for graph-related operations on the social network, such as calculating the number of communities (connected components) and finding the most sociable community (the component with the longest path).
    InMemoryRepository<ID,E>
    In-memory implementation of the Repository interface, using a Map.
    Main
    Main application entry point.
    NetworkService
    Service responsible for managing social network business logic: adding/removing users, establishing/removing friendships, and retrieving network-related statistics.
    Repository<ID,E>
    Generic CRUD interface for managing entities.
    RepositoryException
    Exception thrown when a repository-level operation fails.
    RepositoryFactory
    Factory class responsible for creating repository instances based on configuration properties.
    RepositoryType
    Enumeration representing the supported repository storage types.
    ServiceException
    Exception thrown when a business or service-level logic error occurs.
    Tuple<E1,E2>
    Generic class for representing a pair of entities/values.
    UI
    User interface component providing a console-based menu for interacting with the social network.
    Utilizator
    Entity modeling a user of the social network.
    UtilizatorDbRepository
    Database repository implementation for managing Utilizator entities.
    UtilizatorFileRepository
    Repository for persisting users into a text file (CSV).
    UtilizatorValidator
    Specific validator for the Utilizator entity.
    ValidationException
    Exception thrown when validation of an entity fails.
    Validator<E>
    Generic interface for entity validation.
